+    """Treat empty values and promise-item placeholders as missing metadata."""
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return not value.strip() or value.strip() == '????'
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return not value or all(is_missing_import_value(item) for item in value)
+    if isinstance(value, dict) and 'name' in value:

+    return not value

+def is_complete_import_record(rec: dict) -> bool:
+    """A complete import has a title, an author, and a publication date."""
+    return all(
+        not is_missing_import_value(rec.get(field))
+        for field in ('title', 'authors', 'publish_date')
